risk_if_not_implemented: Without Privileged Functions Logging, users, services and processes may obtain or retain access beyond authorized need, enabling misuse or escalation. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Content of Event Logs
compensating_control_1.justification: Content of Event Logs (MON-09) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Privileged Functions Logging (MON-14) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Storage Capacity
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to allocate and proactively manage sufficient event log and security-relevant telemetry storage capacity to reduce the likelihood of such capacity being exceeded.
compensating_control_2.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Storage Capacity (MON-10) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Privileged Functions Logging (MON-14) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
